annotation.authors_or_issuer: Sanayi ve Teknoloji Bakanlığı (Ministry of Industry and Technology, Türkiye)
key_provisions_or_claims: Sets type-approval rules and technical requirements for automated driving systems (ADS) in fully autonomous M and N category vehicles.
Covers fully autonomous vehicles for defined areas, fixed routes, and automated parking, including dual-mode vehicles.
Defines ADS terms: ODD, DDT, minimal risk manoeuvre, remote intervention operator, in-vehicle operator.
Type approval follows technical specifications in Annex II, assessed by approval authorities or technical services under Annex III.
Harmonises with EU Regulation 2022/1426 and 2019/2144; takes effect on publication.
annotation.summary_en: Turkish Ministry of Industry and Technology regulation, published in the Official Gazette on 1 December 2024. It sets type-approval procedures and technical requirements for automated driving systems in fully autonomous M and N category vehicles. It transposes EU Regulation 2022/1426 and defines key ADS terms and administrative provisions.

annotation.title_en: Regulation on Type Approval of Motor Vehicles with Regard to the Automated Driving System of Fully Automated Vehicles (EU/2022/1426)
